name: Reflect
definition: Reflect: ranged attacks against it bounce back to the attacker. Hit it up close or with area effects.

name: Dive
definition: Dive: flies straight at you (up to %d tiles), knocking each unit it passes %d tile aside, then strikes for %d.

name: Flying
definition: Flying: moves over traps, surfaces, Bramble and Ice Pillars and takes no surface damage. Can still be pushed.

name: Thornwall
definition: Bramble: blocks movement for 3 more round(s). A unit pushed into it takes 2 damage and Bleeds.

name: Lob Slag
definition: Lob Slag

name: Charge
definition: Charge <n>/3: at 3 it discharges chain lightning.

name: Mirror
definition: Mirror: it copies the last attack you played — <card>: <damage> damage.

name: Icefall
definition: Icefall: icicles fall on the marked tiles on the Seer's next turn.

name: Wind
definition: Wind: at the end of each enemy turn, everything not anchored is pushed one tile with the wind.

name: Tether
definition: Tether: lightning strikes every tile between the two Arc Thralls for 4 and Shocks. Break the line to stop it.

name: Veiled
definition: Veiled: only attacks from an adjacent tile, or area effects, can hit it.

name: Burrow
definition: Burrowed; marks your current tile. Erupt is its next intent.

name: Erupt
definition: Surfaces at the mark, displaces its occupant, pushes adjacent units, leaves Rubble and gains Expose 2.

name: Bursts
definition: When this dies, it deals the shown damage to everything next to it.

name: Raise Cover
definition: Spend 1 independent Move and all Stoneskin. Place cover within 2 with that much HP.

name: Reclaim Cover
definition: Spend 1 independent Move to remove adjacent owned cover and recover its surviving HP as Stoneskin.

name: Shape Ground
definition: Creates a surface in the shown area.

name: Fire
definition: Deals 3 damage on turn start and 2 damage when entered.

name: Ice
definition: Entering or starting a turn on Ice applies Chilled.

name: Electrified
definition: Lightning spreads through connected Electrified tiles. Chain can jump through these tiles to reach other targets.

name: Rubble
definition: Costs 2 movement to leave.

name: Chilled
definition: Takes +2 attack damage. An Ice hit Freezes this character and consumes the Ice beneath them.

name: Detonate
definition: Consumes Fire tiles to damage targets on them and their four neighboring tiles.

name: Consume Ground
definition: Consumes the shown surface to gain its reward.

name: Relocate Ground
definition: Moves a surface to another tile.

name: Melee
definition: Deals damage up close.

name: Ranged
definition: Deals damage from a distance.

name: Pierce
definition: Deals damage straight through block and stoneskin.

name: Move
definition: Moves across board tiles.

name: Retreat
definition: Moves away from the target.

name: Blink
definition: Teleports to another tile.

name: Range
definition: Maximum target distance in tiles.

name: Block
definition: Absorbs damage until your next turn.

name: Stoneskin
definition: Persistent armor that absorbs damage across turns.

name: Heal
definition: Restores health.

name: Draw
definition: Adds cards to your hand.

name: Card Play
definition: Adds card plays for this turn.

name: Flurry
definition: Repeats this card once per remaining card play, spending them all. Pays Time once.

name: Follow-up
definition: Gains the listed bonus if you already played a card this turn.

name: Empower
definition: Optional: pay the listed extra cost while playing this card to gain the listed bonus.

name: Stagger
definition: Delays the target's next turn by this much Time. Dragons take half. At most 6 per enemy each turn.

name: Time
definition: Delays your next turn. Each unused play takes 5.

name: Illusion
definition: Creates a stationary copy that enemies can target.

name: Illuminate
definition: Creates a light that reveals nearby Umbra tiles.

name: Vision
definition: Expands the light centered on you.

name: Truesight
definition: Reveals and permits targeting enemies through the Umbra.

name: Dispel Umbra
definition: Reduces this combat's Umbra stage.

name: Eclipse
definition: Forces the arena into absolute Umbra. Radiance and light offer protection.

name: Bleed
definition: Deals damage before moving or attacking. Lasts through the next turn.

name: Expose
definition: The next hit against this target deals extra damage.

name: Sunder
definition: Breaks block and stoneskin before damage lands.

name: Exhaust
definition: Removes this card from the deck for the rest of combat.

name: Consume
definition: Uses this item card once, then removes it from the run.

name: Retaliate
definition: Until your next turn, an enemy that hits you in melee takes this much damage (Block and Stoneskin absorb it) and any listed riders. Several Retaliates add up.

name: Quicken
definition: Your next card this turn costs this much less Time (minimum 1). Several Quickens add up; unused Quicken ends with your turn.

name: Rite
definition: Rite: Exhaust. Lasts for the rest of this combat.

name: Next Attack
definition: Your next attack on a later card this turn gains the shown bonus, then the bonus is spent. Unused bonuses end with your turn.

name: Swap
definition: Swap places with a visible one-tile enemy or one of your illusions. Both of you arrive normally; nothing collides, and Anchored does not stop it.

name: Petrify
definition: The enemy skips its next turn (the skipped turn still costs its Time) and gains Block that lasts through your next turn. Not Freeze: no extra damage. Dragons are immune.

name: Cleanse
definition: Removes the listed statuses from you: Bleed, Immobilize, Chilled or Shock.

name: Skate
definition: This turn, moving onto Ice costs no movement and Ice doesn't Chill you.

name: Anchored
definition: Until your next turn, you can't be pushed or pulled: Push and Pull move you 0 tiles and never collide.

name: Fireproof
definition: Fire doesn't damage you this turn.

name: Convert Ground
definition: Turns the chosen surface tile, and every tile of it connected to it when shown, into another surface. Each enemy on a converted tile takes the damage.

name: Discharge
definition: Removes a connected Electrified network. Each enemy on it or next to it takes the damage once.

name: Sweeping Strike
definition: Hits every enemy you can see that meets the shown condition. There is no target to choose, and enemies hidden by the Umbra are never hit.

name: Swap Illusion
definition: You and one of your illusions trade tiles. Both of you trigger the ground and traps where you land. Immobilize prevents it.

name: Shatter Illusion
definition: Destroys one of your illusions to blast each enemy next to it.

name: Freeze
definition: Skips the next turn and takes triple attack damage.

name: Shock
definition: Cancels the next non-movement action.

name: Immobilize
definition: Prevents movement and Blink next turn.

name: Chain
definition: Jumps between targets within the shown range. Electrified tiles extend its reach.

name: Push
definition: Forces the target away in one straight line. If it's stopped early, it collides.

name: Pull
definition: Forces the target closer in one straight line. If it's stopped early, it collides.

name: Collision
definition: A stopped Push or Pull deals 2 damage per tile not moved to the target and to whatever stopped it. Walls take nothing. Block and Stoneskin absorb it.

name: Health
definition: Health paid or restored.

name: Health Cost
definition: Health paid to play this card.

name: Area Attack
definition: Affects a pattern of board tiles.

name: Lightning Strikes
definition: Calls down lightning across several marked tiles.

name: Summon Minions
definition: Adds new enemy units to the battle.

name: Raise Terrain
definition: Creates attackable terrain on the board.

name: Terrain Burst
definition: Ruptures the arena around surviving terrain.

name: Kindle Ground
definition: Creates Fire on the marked tiles.

name: Crownfire
definition: Consumes Fire to damage targets on it and its four neighboring tiles.

name: Hollow Gale
definition: Sweeps the target through the arena.

name: Crystal Mantle
definition: Each layer prevents one direct damaging hit, then breaks.

name: Guard Ally
definition: Grants block to another enemy.

name: Heal Ally
definition: Restores another enemy's health.

name: The Last Eclipse
definition: Forces the arena into absolute Umbra.

name: Radiance
definition: Carries protective light into the Umbra.

name: Embers
definition: Run currency used to gain permanent levels.

name: The Run
definition: The full journey from entry to victory or defeat.

name: Map and Rooms
definition: Routes and room types across the labyrinth.

name: Character and Loadout
definition: Equipment, attuned magic, items, relics, and skills.

name: Rewards
definition: Cards, healing, and other prizes claimed during a run.

name: Relics
definition: Passive run modifiers collected during exploration.

name: Combat Board
definition: The tactical tile grid where actions resolve.

name: Turn Clock
definition: Orders the next actor by current initiative delay.

name: Health and Defenses
definition: Health protected by block and stoneskin.

name: Defiance
definition: A per-run rescue that restores health after lethal loss.

name: Targeting
definition: Range, line of sight, patterns, and legal targets.

name: Fatigue
definition: Direct health loss caused by reshuffling an empty deck.

name: Traps
definition: Board hazards triggered by movement or attacks.

name: The Umbra
definition: Darkness that conceals tiles, enemies, and threats.

name: Worldspines
definition: Tharokh's attackable stone spires.

name: Fire
definition: Shapes dangerous ground and consumes it in powerful blasts.

name: Ice
definition: Prepares Ice, Chills exposed units and Freezes with a later Ice hit.

name: Lightning
definition: Conducts through Electrified ground and rewards connected targets.

name: Air
definition: Controls positioning with movement, Push and Pull.

name: Earth
definition: Creates Rubble and persistent Stoneskin defense.

name: Quick Wits
definition: Once per combat, discard a card to gain @icon(draw) 1. Costs no @icon(card_play) or @icon(time).

name: Measured Breath
definition: At turn end, bank up to one unused @icon(card_play) for your next turn.

name: Ghost Stride
definition: Once per combat, activate to turn your next movement into @icon(blink) 2.

name: Discerning Eye
definition: Once between bosses, replace every card in a combat reward.

name: Rehearsed Escape
definition: Once per combat, activate to discard your next non-item @icon(exhaust) card after use.

name: Makeshift Tool
definition: Once per combat, activate to discard your next item after use instead of @icon(consume).

name: Carry the Guard
definition: Once per combat, activate while you have @icon(block) to convert your remaining @icon(block) into @icon(stoneskin) at turn end.

name: Pain Remembers
definition: After you first lose @icon(health) each combat, the next non-item card discarded while your hand has room returns to it.

name: Sure-Footed
definition: Once per combat, ignore the first @icon(traps) hit or Air @icon(traps) @icon(push) against you.

name: Afterimage
definition: Once per combat, your first @icon(blink) leaves an @icon(illusion) 2 at its origin.

name: Deferred Choice
definition: Skip a card reward to save one offered card. It replaces one card in your next reward.

name: Salvager
definition: Once between bosses, recover the first equipment drop left uncollected after victory.

name: Borrowed Time
definition: The first card paid for with a banked @icon(card_play) each combat adds no @icon(time).

name: Last Reserve
definition: Once per combat, lethal @icon(fatigue) leaves you at @icon(health) 1.

name: Plunderer's Step
definition: The first @icon(move) or @icon(blink) to collect loot each combat refunds its @icon(card_play).

name: Prismatic Instinct
definition: Once per combat, place @icon(surface_fire), @icon(surface_ice), @icon(surface_electrified) or @icon(surface_rubble) within @icon(range) 4. Costs no @icon(card_play) or @icon(time).

name: Curator's Patience
definition: After choosing a relic, save one unchosen relic for your next relic offer.

name: Living Shadow
definition: Once between your turns, when @icon(illusion) is destroyed or dispelled, return your most recently discarded non-item card to hand—or put it atop your draw pile if your hand is full.

name: True Bearing
definition: Before combat, choose an open starting tile within @icon(range) 2 of the entrance.

name: Layaway
definition: Once between bosses, hold one ware for the next Scavenger visit. A pending hold blocks future uses until it returns.

name: Encore
definition: Once per combat, return a non-item card from discard to your hand. Costs no @icon(card_play) or @icon(time).

name: Open Arsenal
definition: Equip any equipment in your trinket slot.

name: Confluence
definition: Once per combat, @icon(surface_relocate) one surface up to @icon(range) 4. Both tiles must be visible and within @icon(range) 4 of you.

name: Last Door
definition: Once between bosses, a non-boss defeat returns you to the previous room at @icon(health) 1.

name: Long Dawn
definition: Temporary @icon(illuminate), @icon(vision), and @icon(truesight) you create last @icon(time) +1.

name: Sunpath
definition: The first @icon(move) or @icon(blink) 3+ each turn leaves @icon(illuminate) 1 @icon(time) 2 on every tile entered. @icon(blink) also covers its origin and destination.

name: Witchlight
definition: Your @icon(illusion) have +1 @icon(illuminate) radius while they last.

name: Dawnbrand
definition: The first direct attack each turn against an enemy in @icon(illuminate) inflicts @icon(expose) 1.

name: Afterglow
definition: When @icon(illusion) is removed during combat, it leaves @icon(illuminate) 1 @icon(time) 2 at its final tile.

name: Open Sky
definition: While you stand in @icon(illuminate), you have @icon(truesight).

name: Skill Point
definition: Earned as you level up. Spend them on skills in the Character menu.

name: Moltshards
definition: You need 1 Moltshard. The first dragon defeated each run grants one.
